BiblicalUsage: genez — treasury, chests. That is the whole of it, and it is enough: 3 occurrences, and in Esther and Ezekiel the meaning never wavers. I keep coming back to the simple reading because the simple reading is the true one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe genez matters because what I treasure shows what I worship. I hold that the simple reading is the true one, and I will not trade it for a clever one.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
